turns.content: A square has area 576 linear units. Find its side length.

In the stated right-triangle and square configuration, show that AXP, CXS, CYR, and BYQ are right triangles and express the sum of their inradii using their total leg length and total hypotenuse length.
Use the geometric relations established in the preceding step to verify that the four small triangles have the required right angles.
Apply the inradius relation justified by the triangle classification established above to the four small triangles, then combine the four expressions.
Simplify the sum of their eight leg lengths using the segment relations in the configuration.
Use the point placement and segment identities in the configuration to simplify the sum of the four hypotenuse lengths.
Use an inradius of 10 square units for ABC to evaluate the sum.
